title: •Tusken Breath Mask
caption: •Tusken Breath Mask (V)
game_text: Deploy on an exterior Tatooine battleground site. X = the face-up destiny number of your Objective. Once per turn, if all your ability on table is provided by aliens, your total ability during battle at a site is +X. This Effect canceled if opponent controls this site.
lore: Sand People use a special mask to reclaim exhaled moisture in the hot, harsh environment of Tatooine. Protects by filtering blowing sand and dispersing excess heat.
copyright: TM & © 1995 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1995 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Printed base is a Utinni Effect; slip banner reads EFFECT, no grabber box. ERRATA: the sheet cover notes errata to card #22 on 17 September 2007 (the stub's game_text_note says the same) — this transcription is what this Remaster sheet prints; the pre-errata wording is not on this sheet. The slip's bottom strip prints a small gold/bronze sphere between the caption and the number (the errata marker, as vs5/49 and vs6/32) — not transcribed as an icon. Slip text matches the stub. Lore matches the wiki and the scan. Premiere prints no expansion ring. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright 1995 (Premiere) not legible. Modern: Virtual Block 4 only (VB4 -pre, 350 px).
